questions.q: What does having good expectations of Allah mean?
options: Thinking well of Allah's decree and promise, especially in hardship
questions.explain: Halimah took the orphan baby, confident that Allah would open the door of provision.

questions.q: What did Abu Bakr RA do as a sign of conviction that his prayer would be answered?
options: Bought the best camels for the Hijrah

questions.q: What does the hadith advise about how to pray?
options: Supplicate with certainty that the prayer will be answered
questions.explain: Allah does not accept a supplication from a heedless, unconvinced heart.
Mustajab is a supplication that is granted.

options: The first yellow milk, rich in nutrients and antibodies
questions.explain: Aminah nursed him for a few days and he received her colostrum.

questions.q: How was Prophet Musa AS returned to his mother?
options: The king of Abyssinia took him
The baby refused to nurse from anyone except his mother
questions.explain: Allah fulfilled His promise by returning Musa to his mother.

questions.q: What is breastfeeding for the child?
questions.explain: The ustaz calls for more children to receive their right to exclusive breastfeeding.

questions.q: A mother's success in breastfeeding depends much on the support of husband, family and community.
questions.explain: True. Breastfeeding is not the mother's job alone.

questions.q: The most expensive milk certainly makes a child smarter.
questions.explain: False. Beware of advertisements and misinformation.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Halimah decides to take the orphan baby
He is nursed exclusively in Banu Sa'd

questions.explain: Aminah and Suwaybah nursed him, Halimah decided, he was nursed in Banu Sa'd, and Halimah's family prospered.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: Stunted growth due to poor nutrition
A report from Allah in the Prophet's own words

questions.explain: A hadith qudsi is from Allah in the Prophet's words, mustajab is an answered prayer, istisqa is the prayer for rain, and stunting is stunted growth.

questions.q: You pray but your heart is heedless and unconvinced. What does this lecture advise?
options: Pray with conviction and bring your heart present
questions.explain: Du'a is a dialogue with Allah, so understand what you say and be sure it is heard.
